o: In the wake of multiple breakups, the family faces major turning points. Meri dips her toe into dating with an awkward but promising speed dating event, while Janelle takes steps toward a spiritual divorce after a freeing trip to New Orleans. Christine and David are settling into married life, but Christine is shaken when her kids begin moving to North Carolina near Janelle, sparking jealousy…

v.n: Sister Wives New Season Trailer | TLC

eps.t: Why I Want To Be a Monogamist
eps.o: Christine and David visit Janelle in North Carolina to celebrate the purchase of her new flower farm property and Kody and Robyn discuss their now monogamist relationship and the possibility of bringing in a new wife.
Meri's speed dating event starts out awkward until she meets an encouraging suitor named Ron and Janelle and Meri discuss what needs to be done to sell Coyote Pass as Kody pushes Robyn to move on.
Mykelti and Tony drive right into a tornado as Christine and David help them move to North Carolina. Kody and Robyn decide to begin anew while someone makes an unexpected pregnancy announcement.
Meri ventures into the wild world of dating apps and Kody struggles to fake it about the new family dynamic, as he and Robyn pack up their home.
With the changing family dynamics, the Browns celebrate the holidays with new traditions.

The Sister Wives are moving on: Meri starts dating; Janelle starts a farm in North Carolina, but an attempt to sell the Coyote Pass land goes bad when Kody considers going behind Meri's back; to make amends, Kody visits each of his exes to apologize.

eps.t: You're Like a Stripper, I'm Like the Pole
eps.o: Meri digs through boxes of her wedding memorabilia that bring up painful memories. Christine and David have their biggest disagreement yet. Kody and Robyn try to improve their rhythm with a dance lesson, and Janelle helps Maddie prepare for labor.

Coyote Pass has finally sold and it's the final chapter in the family's breakup. Kody, Robyn, Janelle, and Meri anxiously prepare to meet on the land to close out the deal. In North Carolina, Maddie has her baby girl.

It's an awkward final showdown at Coyote Pass with Kody, Robyn, Janelle, and Meri. Janelle takes a trip to New Orleans and let's loose with girlfriends to celebrate, and Kody considers finding a therapist to help repair relationships with his children.

Janelle celebrates the sale of Coyote Pass by partying with friends in New Orleans. Meri ventures out of her comfort zone and attends a dating event in Las Vegas. Kody owns up to his bad behavior and decides to apologize to each of his ex-wives.

Kody travels to North Carolina to meet with Janelle and apologize, but she questions his motives. Meri gets out of her comfort zone at a dating event in Las Vegas. During a game of pickleball, Christine talks to David about Kody's request to meet.

eps.t: What If We Worked This Out?
eps.o: Kody is nervous about his second apology as he meets up with Christine and David. Janelle's friends ask her if she would ever get back with Kody. Ron meets Meri's friends for the first time as she hosts a fundraiser for Jenn's husband.

Kody's apology to Christine starts well but gets tense when David brings up Kody's relationships with his kids. Janelle seeks guidance from Meri on getting her spiritual release. Meri's shocked friends try to talk her out of meeting up with Kody.
The Sister Wives are moving on as Meri begins dating and Janelle starts a farm in North Carolina but an attempt to sell the Coyote Pass land goes bad when Kody considers going behind Meri's back.
Janelle meets up with Meri to discuss her spiritual release.Kody gives a final apology to Robyn and asks for forgiveness.

The Brown family sits down to discuss their past and future. As Christine says she tried to make her relationship with Kody work, he says that the wives all had the same chances as Robyn. The family comments on Meri's legal divorce from Kody.

The One-on-One conversations continue as Kody shares that Coyote Pass was a major influence on his apologies to his ex-wives. David explains why Kody's apology to Christine offended him, and Robyn reveals her part in the backdoor deal.

In part three of this One-on-One special, Meri and Janelle discuss the early years of their marriage to Kody and the difficulties they faced. Meri reveals the awkwardness around Janelle's past marriage to her brother. David and Christine address the competition between wives in plural marriage.

In this final episode of the One-on-One interviews, Meri and Kody talk about their dark times in Vegas. Kody defends Robyn and accuses the other wives of using her as a scapegoat. Meri is asked about the new man in her life.
